rules.title: Elemental Mastery
rules.content:
Certain character skills and equipment will increase your Elemental Mastery.
Increasing Elemental Mastery can enhance the DMG dealt — and the effects caused — by your Elemental Reactions.
For example: For every 1 Elemental Mastery you gain, the Shields bestowed by your Crystallize reactions will be increased by 3 stacks.

rules.title: Extra Actions
rules.content: When a character gains Extra Actions, they will have more chances to use their skills. However, skills unleashed during Extra Actions will not accumulate Energy.
rules.contentraw: When a character gains Extra Actions, they will have more chances to use their skills. However, skills unleashed during Extra Actions will not accumulate Energy.

rules.title: Charging
rules.content: If a character's skill needs to be charged, they must consume actions to perform charges. When they have performed enough charges to fully charge their skill, they will be able to unleash that skill during their next action.

rules.title: Auto: Plunging Attack
rules.content: After a character has had this effect attached, when this character is the active character — at the beginning of a Round or after being switched in — they will deal Physical DMG to the opponent's active character based on the number of stacks.
